dict.string: Vishnu uses the camera only for connection-code scanning and owner-approved Vision, document, pose, and spatial Sensorium sessions while the app is visibly active.
Vishnu uses the microphone only for owner-approved voice or temporary environmental-audio Sensorium sessions. Environmental sensing keeps local features, not continuous raw audio.
Vishnu uses your location and compass only during an owner-approved Sensorium location session to understand current context. Location access stops with the session.
Vishnu uses motion, orientation and barometer data only during an owner-approved Sensorium motion session.
Vishnu discovers and connects securely to your paired Vishnu computer on your local network.
